name: Ootori Chikage
source:
Tooru's classmate and student president. Always reading with the cover hidden in class. The perfect girl with brains and beauty... or is she?

(From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361760/Real_Anime_Situation_2/]Steam page[/url])

Likes: Fast food, studying (perverted things), playing games (also watching AVs, reading eromanga and watching eroanime)
Dislikes: Food that takes long to make, cooking in general
